rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for giving up hope or being in a state of utter hopelessness.

example.english: Alone in a strange city, I was in such desperation that I didn’t know what to do.
example.traditional: 我一個人喺陌生城市，真係絕望到唔知點算。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 hai2 mak6 saang1 sing4 si5 zan1 hai6 zyut6 mong6 dou3 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3
